Select canonical_smiles, molecule_chembl_id, standard_type, standard_relation, standard_value, standard_units for assay CHEMBL1614455. Join molecule_dictionary to activities on molregno, join assays on assay_id, and join compound_structures as an INNER JOIN on molregno. Filter to exact measurements where standard_relation is '=' and standard_value and standard_relation are not null. Return all qualifying activity rows without deduplication. Sort by canonical_smiles, molecule_chembl_id, standard_type, standard_relation, standard_value, and standard_units.
